object: The symmetric quadratic coefficient tensor of value_reader @ down applied to the native MLP8 numerator, restricted to the leading right-singular-vector subspaces of the centered opened-fixture z and delta vectors.
consequence: Within the standard exact program class consisting of r scalar products of pairs of linear forms followed by arbitrary 128-dimensional output writers, the 16-dimensional witness restriction requires r >= 128. This is a robust numerical flattening-rank witness for the stored FP32 map, not a formal interval certificate.
limitations: The witness basis was selected from opened fixture activations; this is not held-out or OOD evidence.
The result is an exact-numerator product-count lower bound, not an approximation-error lower bound.
The common live RMS denominator and downstream full QK1*QK2*V product are outside this numerator bound.
The result establishes neither causal fidelity, selective manipulation, composition/reuse, nor semantic identifiability.
